blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mitsubishi Motors Philippines Corp. is keeping a close watch on the government’s automotive policies, including those of the next administration, before deciding whether to expand local production of internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles or shift further towards electrified models.
